items.text: Rock music is coming out of my computer.
As a rock music lover, I play the electric guitar in the school band.
Sometimes I write songs and share them online.
There is so much fun in music.
Right at this moment, the sound of Grandpa’s erhu cuts in.
Music is also my grandpa’s hobby.
He likes playing the erhu in the park with his friends.
An idea suddenly hits me: “Why don’t we put our music together?”
We can learn from different kinds of music because they bring us together.
“Grandpa!” I rush into his room.
I decide to take part in the school art festival with Grandpa this year.
After a week’s practice, we are on the stage.
I nod to Grandpa and we fire up our instruments.
It feels great to enjoy our hobby together.
Rock music is coming out of my computer.
As a rock music lover, I play the electric guitar and share songs online.
Grandpa likes a different kind of music.
He plays the erhu and sings Beijing opera with friends.
An idea suddenly hits me: “Why don’t we put our music together?”
After a week’s practice, Grandpa and I take part in the school art festival.
We fire up our instruments on the stage.
Everybody moves with our music, and we enjoy our hobby together.
At home, rock music is playing on Li Ming’s computer.
He loves rock music and plays the electric guitar in the school band.
Sometimes he writes songs and shares them online.
Music brings him a lot of fun.
At this moment, the sound of Grandpa’s erhu cuts in.
Li Ming knows that music is Grandpa’s hobby too.
Grandpa likes playing the erhu in the park with his friends, but his music is very different from rock music.
An idea suddenly hits Li Ming: “Why don’t we put our music together?”
This idea makes him excited.
Then he rushes into Grandpa’s room.
This year, Li Ming decides to take part in the school art festival with Grandpa.
After a week’s practice, they are on the stage.
Li Ming nods to Grandpa, and they fire up their instruments.
Everybody moves with their music.
It feels great to enjoy their hobby together.
Suddenly, a door appears in the wall.
Emma shakes her head and stops writing.
There are no old classmates here.
She feels a bit lonely.
Emma likes writing magic stories.
She wants to make friends and share the joy of writing.
An idea hits her.
Please write more!
Emma puts the notebook on a shelf and leaves.
A week later, Emma’s notebook is still on the shelf in the library.
There are pages of new writing by different people!
How about starting a writing group?
Let’s meet here on Wednesday after lunch.
As a result, Emma makes friends through writing.
It’s the best ending to my story.
Emma is new at this school and feels a bit lonely.
She likes writing magic stories and wants to make friends.
In the library, an idea hits her.
She writes in her notebook, “Do you like the story? Please write more!”
Then she puts it on a shelf and leaves.
A week later, she opens it and sees pages of new writing.
A note suggests starting a writing group.
It is the best ending to her story.
Emma is in the library with her notebook.
In her magic story, a door suddenly appears in the wall.
She reads the line again, shakes her head and stops writing.
As a new student, Emma does not know many classmates yet, so she feels a bit lonely.
Emma likes writing magic stories.
She wants to make friends and share the joy of writing.
Then an idea hits her: she can use her notebook.
She writes a message for other students: “Hello! Do you like the story? Please write more!”
After that, Emma puts the notebook on a shelf and leaves.
A week later, Emma’s notebook is still on the shelf in the library.
She opens it nervously.
There are pages of new writing by different people.
On the last page, someone writes, “How about starting a writing group? Let’s meet here on Wednesday after lunch.”
Emma smiles and thinks, “It’s the best ending to my story.”
